_comment: IMMUTABLE ordered plan (Rule 1). A daily run advances step_pointer or raises a blocker; it may NOT re-order, redefine, or invent steps. Status is DERIVED from git+CI (Rule 2), never asserted here. 'gate' = the verifiable artifact that proves the step done. 'human_block' steps must DIE and wait (Rule 8).

steps.title: Scaffold: repo + README (with lit-citations + honest 'empirical study, not whitepaper' framing) + pytest + CI + MIT license
steps.gate: repo exists at neil-cipher/sketchflow; CI green on an empty passing test; README present at HEAD
steps.concept: version control, CI, project hygiene
steps.human_block: first-push / repo-create if gh cannot create it non-interactively

steps.title: Synthetic Zipfian stream generator (seeded) + exact dict/set baseline counter
steps.gate: test: baseline exact counts == collections.Counter on same seeded stream
steps.concept: streams, ground truth, Zipf/heavy-tail distributions

steps.title: Hash family: multiply-shift + tabulation hashing, seedable, k independent functions
steps.gate: test: distribution uniformity + pairwise-independence sanity (chi-square within tolerance)
steps.concept: universal/pairwise-independent hashing (the assumption CMS rests on)

steps.title: Bloom filter warm-up: bit array + k hashes, add/query, no false negatives
steps.gate: test: zero false negatives ever; false-positive rate within analytic (1-e^{-kn/m})^k tolerance
steps.concept: bit arrays, probabilistic membership, one-sided error

steps.title: Bloom sizing calculator: given n & target FPR -> (m,k); verified empirically
steps.gate: test: empirical FPR at chosen (m,k) <= target on 10k-item stream
steps.concept: space/accuracy trade-off, closed-form parameter sizing

steps.title: Count-Min Sketch skeleton: (depth d x width w) counter matrix + add()
steps.gate: test: after adds, every row cell for an item >= true count (no undercount)
steps.concept: 2D counter sketch, the never-undercount invariant

steps.title: CMS point query = min over rows; ε/δ <-> (w=ceil(e/ε), d=ceil(ln 1/δ)) sizing
steps.gate: test: |estimate - true| <= ε*N with prob >= 1-δ across many seeds
steps.concept: min-estimator, the ε·N additive error bound

steps.title: CMS memory accounting + serialize/deserialize; property tests
steps.gate: test: bytes reported == actual; round-trip serialize preserves all estimates
steps.concept: measuring real memory footprint honestly

steps.title: CMS inner-product / join-size estimate between two sketches
steps.gate: test: estimated inner product within ε bound of true dot product of frequency vectors
steps.concept: linear sketches compose; sketches as vectors

steps.title: Conservative-update CMS (increment only minimum cells)
steps.gate: test: CU estimate <= plain-CMS estimate for every item on same stream; still never undercounts
steps.concept: conservative update reduces overestimation error

steps.title: Space-Saving top-k: monitored counters + eviction of the min
steps.gate: test: reported top-k == exact top-k on a stream where heavy hitters exceed the 1/k threshold
steps.concept: bounded-memory heavy hitters, the Space-Saving guarantee

steps.title: Space-Saving min-heap + hash index for O(log k) update
steps.gate: test: same results as step 10 but throughput scales; heap invariant asserted
steps.concept: heap + hashmap combo for fast approximate top-k

steps.title: CMS + Space-Saving combined: estimate counts AND surface heavy hitters
steps.gate: test: end-to-end on synthetic stream returns correct heavy hitters with CMS-estimated counts
steps.concept: composing sketches into an analytics engine

steps.title: Benchmark harness v1: exact baseline vs CMS/CU/SS over synthetic streams; emit CSV
steps.gate: test: harness runs headless, writes report/results.csv with error+memory columns
steps.concept: reproducible experiment design

steps.title: Accuracy-vs-memory sweep: vary width/depth; plot error decay (matplotlib -> PNG)
steps.gate: artifact: report/accuracy_vs_memory.png regenerable from CSV via one command
steps.concept: reading a space/accuracy curve; reproducibility

steps.title: HUMAN: fetch CIC-IDS-2017 CSV via Kaggle mirror (account/accept wall)
steps.gate: data/cicids_sample.csv present + checksum recorded in decisions.log
steps.concept: real datasets, provenance, checksums
steps.human_block: Kaggle login/accept + download is a credential wall

steps.title: CIC-IDS loader -> 5-tuple flow keys; run engine on real flow stream
steps.gate: test: loader parses sample rows; engine top-k over real flows matches exact top-k on the sample
steps.concept: mapping real network records to stream keys

steps.title: HUMAN: fetch one MAWI daily pcap (no login; large file)
steps.gate: data/mawi_sample.pcap present + size/checksum in decisions.log
steps.concept: backbone traffic traces
steps.human_block: large download + possible dpkt/scapy parse dependency install

steps.title: MAWI pcap -> flow-key stream (dpkt); engine runs on real backbone traffic
steps.gate: test: pcap reader yields flow keys; benchmark runs end-to-end on MAWI sample
steps.concept: packet parsing, 5-tuple flows at scale

steps.title: Adversary v1: collision-maximising input that forces CMS overestimate
steps.gate: test: adversarial stream provably raises mean estimation error vs random stream at same memory
steps.concept: worst-case vs average-case; attacking a probabilistic guarantee

steps.title: Guarantee-violation meter: measure empirical P(error > εN) vs the promised δ
steps.gate: test: on benign streams empirical violation rate <= δ; on adversarial streams it is quantified
steps.concept: does the ε/δ promise actually hold? measuring it

steps.title: CU vs plain CMS under adversarial load: does conservative update survive the attack?
steps.gate: artifact: report/adversarial.csv comparing violation rates; finding written to decisions.log
steps.concept: which variant is robust, and why — the core empirical finding

steps.title: Adversary on real traces: replay MAWI/CIC with heavy-hitter amplification
steps.gate: artifact: report/real_adversarial.png; where the bound holds vs breaks on real data
steps.concept: bridging theory stress-test to real backbone traffic

steps.title: Empirical study report v1 (Markdown): method, curves, adversarial findings, honest limits
steps.gate: report/EMPIRICAL_STUDY.md present, every claim cited, regenerable figures referenced
steps.concept: writing up results honestly, sourcing every claim

steps.title: One-command reproducibility: `make reproduce` regenerates all CSVs + figures from seeds
steps.gate: CI job runs `make reproduce` clean from scratch
steps.concept: reproducible research as a deliverable

steps.title: README polish: hook, lit-citations, results summary, 'how to verify me in 5 min', pedagogy notes index
steps.gate: README renders; links resolve; reviewer-verifiable in 5 minutes
steps.concept: communicating work to a recruiter/adcom

steps.title: Green checkpoint tag + final invariant sweep + coverage badge
steps.gate: tag green-sketchflow-final; all tests green; coverage reported
steps.concept: shipping: tags, coverage, done-means-verifiable

steps.title: OPTIONAL stretch: HyperLogLog cardinality (clearly labelled optional; magic constants explained not cargo-culted)
steps.gate: test: HLL cardinality within ~2% on known-distinct-count synthetic stream
steps.concept: cardinality estimation; only if the core is fully green first
